scientific_target.question: Over verified common sampled-interval support, do short and long prior contexts differ in a prespecified retrospective Set–Go neural-trajectory contrast after response-modality/direction and temporal-block controls, and what within-session uncertainty supports that conclusion?
scientific_target.known_answer: An independently recomputed matched-prior difference in measured response-conditioned neural trajectories on complete prespecified interval/modality/direction/block support, with its support and within-session uncertainty. Null, reversed and unsupported contrasts are valid; the empirical value is not supplied by the paper narrative. Authentic raw Set–Go observations are prepared for the declared204-row/54-unit scope; the scientific trajectory basis, matched-support estimand, independent reference and uncertainty remain unqualified.
scientific_target.answer_origin: The authenticated DANDI000130 training asset supplies native spike timestamps, Ready/Set/Go events and prior/nominal-interval/modality/direction metadata. The accepted preparation validates native event ordering and complete unit observation support and retains every spike in [Set,Go); it selects source ts==800 and uses native set_time/go_time directly, without behavioral tp or outcome/outlier fields. A scientific contrast and held-block uncertainty still require prespecified train-only choices and an independent reference; source preparation alone is not that answer.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete declared Haydn20161211 source-session packet: all204 nominal800ms source train/validation trials,150train+54validation,54released source-training units and six observed recording segments. Exact trial/unit identities are bound in the prepared packet. A scientific matched-support case/aggregation must still account for three empty prior×effector×direction cells; the177-row pre-Set calibration roster is not substituted.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One already exposed monkey/session. The54units,204trials,20phase bins and six recording observation segments are not independent animals or verified randomized assignment blocks. Within-session uncertainty requires an independently justified dependence/schedule model; no cross-animal replication is supplied.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective conditional association of prior context with neural trajectories. Full Set–Go alignment is conditioned on the eventual response and cannot support prospective interval prediction or a unique causal timing mechanism. The original evaluation phrase about held-out interval-loss is not satisfied by numerical selected-count reconstruction. The preserved original held-out interval-loss wording is an unresolved metadata inconsistency, not a source-grounded substitute endpoint; prospective behavioral prediction remains separate.
